title: UI VOLUME SILENCES THE FIND SOUNDS
why: Found in the cloud hunt of 2026-10-15: the UI VOLUME row promises PICKUPS, but the find sounds (a rare, elite, gun or uncommon pickup) play through their own dry output (sndFindOut), which took only the effects level and went straight out, skipping the UI bus. So at UI VOLUME OFF every find still played at full. Proven in headless Chromium with a stand-in audio context: {"off":0.8,"full":0.8} (the find gain at UI VOLUME OFF and FULL, effects level 0.8). The find output now takes the effects level times UI VOLUME, so OFF silences it and FULL is exactly as before.
now: UI VOLUME now turns down the pickup sounds for rare finds and guns too.

edits.anchor: try{ g=a.createGain(); g.gain.value=B.gain.value; o=netSndOut(a)||a.destination; g.connect(o); }catch(e){ return null; }
edits.replacement:
// v16.xx (cloud-menus-ui-volume-finds), CLOUD HUNT 2026-10-15: a find sound is a pickup, so UI VOLUME scales it too; it skips the UI bus, so OFF never silenced it
  try{ g=a.createGain(); g.gain.value=B.gain.value*volOf('volUi'); o=netSndOut(a)||a.destination; g.connect(o); }catch(e){ return null; }
